meta.name: baoyu-post-to-weibo
meta.description: Posts content to Weibo (微博). Supports regular posts with text, images, and videos, and headline articles (头条文章) with Markdown input via Chrome CDP. Use when user asks to "post to Weibo", "发微博", "发布微博", "publish to Weibo", "share on Weibo", "写微博", or "微博头条文章".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动将内容发布到微博
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定时或批量发布微博内容
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to schedule or batch post to Weibo

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用真实的 Chrome 浏览器把内容填进微博发布页:支持文字配图片或视频的普通微博,也支持用 Markdown 写的头条文章。内容填好后由你手动检查并发布。
howto.when: 当你说「发微博」「发布微博」「写微博」等,或要发头条文章时接管。没指定类型时,Markdown 文件走头条文章,纯文本或带图走普通微博。

say.text: 帮我把这段文字和三张图发成一条微博
say.note: 会打开浏览器填好内容,你确认后手动发布

say.text: 把 article.md 发成微博头条文章
say.note: 会打开头条文章编辑器,插入正文和配图,并做占位符检查

say.text: 发一条带视频的微博,视频用 ./clip.mp4
say.note: 会把视频填进发布框,等你审核

howto.what_en: Claude fills your text, images, videos, or Markdown articles into the real Weibo site in Chrome. It handles regular posts and headline articles; you review and publish manually.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to post to Weibo ("发微博", "写微博", etc.) or for a headline article. With no type given, a .md file goes to headline article; plain text or text with images goes to a regular post.

say_en.text: Post this text with these three images to Weibo
say_en.note: Opens Chrome with the content filled in; you publish manually

say_en.text: Publish article.md as a Weibo headline article
say_en.note: Opens the article editor, inserts body and images, checks placeholders

say_en.text: Post a video to Weibo using ./clip.mp4
say_en.note: Fills the video into the post box for your review
